implemented_requirements.requirement: Two-player vertical paddles controlled by separate keys
implemented_requirements.evidence: paddle.py defines Paddle class with up_key and down_key parameters; Game creates paddle_left with keys K_w/K_s and paddle_right with K_UP/K_DOWN.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Paddles move up and down and stay within screen bounds
implemented_requirements.evidence: Paddle.update() reads pygame.key.get_pressed() and clamps self.y between 0 and SCREEN_HEIGHT - height.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Ball moves and bounces off top and bottom edges
implemented_requirements.evidence: Ball.update() checks y < 0 and y > SCREEN_HEIGHT - size, reversing speed_y accordingly.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Ball bounces off paddles with angle variation and speed increase
implemented_requirements.evidence: Ball.bounce_off_paddle() computes offset, adjusts angle using MAX_BOUNCE_ANGLE, increments speed up to BALL_MAX_SPEED, and reverses horizontal direction.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Scoring when a player misses the ball
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.update() adds to score_right when ball.rect.right < 0 and to score_left when ball.rect.left > SCREEN_WIDTH.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Winning score threshold and game‑over state
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.update() checks if score_left or score_right >= WINNING_SCORE (settings.WINNING_SCORE) and switches to STATE_GAME_OVER.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Ball reset after each point with a short serve delay
implemented_requirements.evidence: Ball.reset() recenters the ball, sets speed, and initializes serve_timer = SERVE_DELAY_FRAMES; Game.update() calls ball.reset() after a score.
Game.handle_events() processes SPACE to start, P to pause/unpause, and R to restart after game over.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Executable entry point that ensures pygame is available
implemented_requirements.evidence: main.py defines ensure_pygame() which installs pygame if missing, then creates and runs Game.

critical_issues: Automatic installation of pygame in main.py may fail in restricted environments, which would prevent execution.
judge.summary: All core Pong features—two controllable paddles, ball physics with edge and paddle bounces, scoring, win condition, and ball reset after points—are fully implemented and integrated. The code appears syntactically correct and logically coherent, with a reasonable chance of running successfully given a functional Python environment with pygame installed. Minor risk exists around the automatic pygame installation step, but overall the submission meets the benchmark requirements.
